desc:
🛴 Someone’s junk. Your next big flip.

Search the junkyard for battered KuKirins, bring them back to life and decide: keep your dream ride or sell it for your next upgrade?

🔧 Repair broken parts and restore neglected scooters
🧽 Wash away the dirt and reveal what’s underneath
🎨 Customize your ride with colors, finishes and upgrades
💸 Negotiate with the reseller and turn repairs into profit
🏠 Upgrade your private garage and grow your collection
🌳 Progress through skill branches and unlock exclusive rides
🔥 Discover exclusive scooters and eBikes
🏍️ Take your scooters and bikes out into the city

From your first junkyard find to a garage full of favorites—what will you build?

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a like and favorite to find your way back!
